name: UICraft（前端设计工具集）
description_zh: 面向生产环境的界面设计能力集：从视觉主张、版式与空间、动效与交互，到无障碍、性能与设计系统治理，帮助做出有观点且经得起验收的前端界面，摆脱千篇一律的 AI 感
description_en: A production-oriented interface craft toolkit spanning visual direction, layout and type, motion and interaction, accessibility, performance, and design-system governance — for building web UI with a real point of view
